messages:
tina: starting an experimental canary for v5.0-quant-hybrid at 7% traffic for 4h. goal: confirm composite-quality parity, especially for multi-turn doc summarization. curious about using a weighted composite metric for fallback instead of single-metric gates. thoughts?
jose: interesting — single metrics (MRR, hallucination) fight each other. composite helps, but need to be careful with weighting across slices. propose sample-weighted composite: C = w1*MRR_rel + w2*(-Hall_abs) + w3*F1_rel, normalized by slice importance.
arjun: ops/infra note: quant-hybrid has variable coldstart depending on shard. recommend a warmup hold of 50m where composite is computed but no auto-fallback. still send alerts.
lily: to avoid blind spots, add an "ensemble-consensus" override: if two independent eval harnesses disagree (one flags regression, the other not), don't auto-fallback until hysteresis satisfied. also use bootstrap CI on composite score.
tina: proposed safety budget idea: allow up to X auto-fallback false positives per week per team; once exceeded, switch to manual-only for next 24h. reduces noisy rollbacks. anyone object?
jose: like safety budget. operationalize with a simple counter in the canary controller and an opt-out flag for critical slices.
arjun: rollback behavior: prefer graceful stepdown 50%->20%->0 over 3min, and backfill to pinned fp32 v4.9. also implement rate-limit on rollback-triggered reroutes to avoid thundering herd.
lily: hysteresis: require 3 consecutive 5m windows where composite delta and its 90% CI lower bound exceed thresholds. for critical slices (billing/auth), require only 1 window. sample floor n>=200.
jose: example canary config (string): ```json
{"auto_fallback":"true","composite_weights":"{\"mrr\":0.5,\"hall_neg\":0.3,\"f1\":0.2}","composite_threshold":"-0.012","ci_method":"bootstrap_90","hysteresis_windows":"3","window_mins":"5","critical_hysteresis":"1","sample_floor":"200","warmup_mins":"50","safety_budget_weekly":"2","rollback_stepdown":"50,20,0","stepdown_duration_mins":"3"}
```
tina: deploy-bot will kick off canary now. action items: Jose to encode composite scoring in monitor; Lily to wire ensemble-consensus check; Arjun to add warmup + rate-limited reroute; I'll draft safety-budget telemetry. reconvene after 4h. :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary started at 4967001234 -> 7% traffic. dashboard: https://console/redwood/canary/4967001234
